name: Kotlin
description: Kotlin is the modern JVM language that is now the primary language for Android development. It is concise, expressive, and fully interoperable with Java. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Kotlin in Action (Chapters Free)
items.description: The authoritative book on Kotlin by the language designers. Full text available via Manning liveBook with free preview chapters covering core language features.

items.title: Atomic Kotlin (Free Chapters)
items.description: A modern approach to learning Kotlin by Bruce Eckel and Svetlana Isakova. Free sample chapters with hands-on exercises.

items.title: Kotlin Docs - Idioms
items.description: A collection of idiomatic Kotlin patterns that teach the language through common use cases and best practices.

items.title: Kotlin Language Docs
items.description: The complete official documentation covering syntax, coroutines, multiplatform, and tooling.

items.title: Kotlin Playground
items.description: Interactive browser-based Kotlin sandbox. Write, compile, and share Kotlin code instantly.

items.title: Kotlin Standard Library Reference
items.description: Complete API reference for the Kotlin standard library with detailed documentation for every function and extension.

items.title: JetBrains — Kotlin Basics Track
items.description: The official JetBrains interactive course covering Kotlin fundamentals, OOP, functional programming, and coroutines with hands-on exercises.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — Kotlin Course
items.description: Free comprehensive Kotlin tutorials and courses covering Android development and backend programming.

items.title: Kotlin Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive multi-hour video course covering Kotlin from scratch to building real applications.

items.title: Android Basics with Compose (Google)
items.description: Google's official free course teaching Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android app development.

items.title: Exercism — Kotlin Track
items.description: 100+ free coding exercises with automated analysis and optional human mentoring.

items.title: Codewars — Kotlin Kata
items.description: Solve community-created challenges in Kotlin across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: LeetCode — Kotlin Support
items.description: Practice data structures and algorithms using Kotlin for interview preparation.

items.title: Kotlin Cheatsheet (devhints)
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering Kotlin syntax, collections, lambdas, and coroutines.

items.title: Kotlin Style Guide
items.description: Official coding conventions and style guide for writing idiomatic Kotlin code.

items.title: Kotlin Weekly
items.description: A curated weekly newsletter covering Kotlin language updates, libraries, Android development, and community highlights.

items.title: Kotlin Blog (JetBrains)
items.description: Official JetBrains blog with release announcements, feature previews, and deep dives into Kotlin language features.

items.title: Reddit r/kotlin
items.description: The largest Kotlin community on Reddit for news, discussions, and showcase projects.

items.title: Kotlin Slack (Official)
items.description: The official Kotlin Slack community with channels for beginners, multiplatform, coroutines, and library authors.

items.title: Kotlin Discord
items.description: A real-time chat community of Kotlin developers for Q&A, code review, and project collaboration.
